tracks.grant_policy: Do not assume ordinary insurance agencies qualify for grants; verify business eligibility and permitted uses.
Record whether a fiscal sponsor or nonprofit applicant is mandatory.

qualification_checks: direct authorization from brand owner or documented authorized distributor
territory and channel rights, including online marketplace restrictions
opening order, minimum annual purchase, inventory and display requirements
storefront, ecommerce, customer service and after-sales requirements
business credit, working capital, insurance and trade references
MAP policy, returns, warranty, repair and product authenticity rules
exclusivity, termination, sell-off and geographic restrictions
tracks.risk_policy: Do not describe wholesale access or authenticated resale as manufacturer-authorized dealership. Verify authorization chain and territory in writing; flag gray-market inventory, counterfeit risk, and unauthorized marketplace restrictions.

identity_matching.privacy: Identity attributes must remain in a private encrypted profile and may be loaded only after explicit opt-in for a specific program; never store them in this public example or telemetry.

global_rules: Separate grants, contracts, scholarships, fellowships, prizes, and loans.
Prefer official program and procurement sources; label secondary aggregators.
Store source URL, retrieval time, last verified date, deadline, award range, applicant type, jurisdiction, eligibility requirements, and status.
Never infer eligibility from identity, credentials, age, or location when a program rule is unclear.
Do not represent a closed or expired opportunity as open.
Do not represent a federal, state, or local contract as a grant.
For insurance procurements, enforce the agency's actual licensing and appointment scope.
Require human review before applications, certifications, registrations, representations, or bids are submitted.
Do not pay an application fee or share tax, banking, identity, or credential documents without explicit approval.
